validity.researcher_notes:
This is NOT simply the whole-system-vs-Kazakh-portion shape the brief's source_ladder guessed at (unlike CAC) -- three-way disagreement, and none of the three numbers I found agree:

1) Sheet LengthKnownKm=877.00 -- the sheet's own 'Length [ref]' cell is BLANK (no citation at all in the live data). gem.wiki attributes 877 km to 'Annual Report 2020, JSC NC KazMunayGas' but I downloaded and full-text-searched (pdftotext -layout) BOTH the Russian and English KMG AR2020 'gas-transportation' PDFs (ar2020.kmg.kz/pdf/ar/{ru,en}/strategic-report_operating_gas-transportation.pdf) for '877' and found zero occurrences in either. I also checked AR2019 and AR2021 -- also zero. So gem.wiki's own citation for 877 does not verify against the actual document; I cannot confirm where 877 comes from.

2) What KMG's Annual Reports actually say: AR2019/AR2020 give ONE COMBINED line item 'МГ БГР-ТБА, Газли-Шымкент' = 2,462 km / 10.2 bcm/y (BGR-TBA = Бухарский газоносный регион - Ташкент-Бишкек-Алматы, i.e. the SEPARATE Bukhara-Tashkent-Bishkek-Almaty system GEM already carries as P0739/P5810). AR2021 restates the SAME combined line at 1,903.40 km / 24.40 bcm/y (verified: 'МГ «БГР-ТБА», «Газли-Шымкент» | 1 903,40 | 24,40' in ar2021.kmg.kz's gas-transportation-and-marketing PDF). Neither combined figure is 877, and per the country notes this vintage swap is a scope redefinition, not a correction -- so even if I used one, it would describe the WRONG system (BGR-TBA + Gazli-Shymkent together), not Gazli-Shymkent alone.

3) A genuinely new, independent, dated (as of 01.01.2025) data point: AO Intergas Central Asia's own official capacity-availability PDF (the same document used for P3955/P3963 in this brief) SPLITS the combined KMG line into its two real components: 'БГР-ТБА (2 нитки, лупинг, перемычки) | 500-1000 | 1 594,4 | 1970 | ...' and, as its own separate named asset, 'Газли-Шымкент | 1200 | 309 | 1988 | 13 505 | 4 380 | 38%' -- diameter 1200mm and year 1988 both match the sheet exactly, but length is 309 km, not 877. (Sanity check: 1,594.4 + 309 = 1,903.4, an exact match to AR2021's combined figure -- so this split is internally consistent with KMG's own numbers, and 309 km is Intergas's own current claimed length for the Kazakh-portion asset it names 'Газли-Шымкент'.)

4) The drawn route (575 km, RouteAccuracy=medium) runs Gazli (63.59E,40.19N, Uzbekistan) -> a point near Tashkent (68.54E,40.98N) -> a point ~40km short of Shymkent (69.49E,41.96N) -- i.e. it traces close to the FULL Uzbekistan-to-Kazakhstan international corridor, not just a Kazakh portion. So the route is scoped differently from Intergas's 309 km Kazakh-only figure, but I have no independent value for the Uzbek portion (Uztransgaz's side) to check whether 575 km is right for the full international line either.

Net: 877 (uncited/unverified), 309 (Intergas's own current Kazakh-portion asset, verified live), and 575 (drawn full-corridor route, unverified independently) are three different numbers describing what may be three different scopes (full int'l line / Kazakh portion only / combined-with-BGR-TBA). I am not proposing a fill because I cannot cleanly attribute any one number to 'this string's own value' with confidence -- this is the honest UNRESOLVED-shape spec question the protocol anticipates, just not the specific shape the brief guessed.
